I couldn't confirm the 8 April renewal date for Brackenwater Freight Co., because there's nothing to check it against in anything Pree can see. I replied to them in a thread under their message in #central-team.

- **What I checked:** Pree's channels (#central-team, #central-random, #general, #help-it-ops, #inc-tansley-carrier-api) and the public files. The shared files have no folder for any account at all. Neither Central digest (the cheat sheet and the 5 Jan handoffs note) mentions Brackenwater.
- **What I told Pree:** I've noted the date as unverified and am not treating it as confirmed. I suggested getting the customer to confirm it in writing, or checking it against the signed contract, before anyone plans around it. I also offered to draft an internal note or set a calendar reminder to follow up.

I didn't use `search_messages` or read channels Pree isn't in. No approval was needed, since a renewal date isn't a finance figure.
